compositionShape.description: v0.7+. Whether this app has one composer (single) or multiple composers / call sites (multi). When `multi`, `composers[]` is the source of truth; when `single`, top-level `layers[]` is the source of truth and `composers[]` may be a back-compat shim of length 1.

composers.description: v0.7+. Per-composer entries. Used for multi-composer / multi-call-site / shared-package shapes. For single-composer apps, this may be a length-1 shim that mirrors top-level layers[].

kind.description: Composer topology kind. single-composer = one composer file (Celestia3 pattern). multi-composer = two or more distinct composer files (626Labs pattern). multi-call-site = no canonical composer; SDK calls scattered inline (WeSeeYou pattern). shared-package = composer in a packages/<name>/ directory referenced across workspaces (Quiz Show pattern).

path.description: Composer location. String for single-file kinds; array of call-site paths for multi-call-site groups.

apiParameterCompleteness.description: Fraction of this composer's layers that have a detected apiParameter (non-null).

type.description: Layer kind. `directive-field` is a v0.5 deprecated alias preserved for backward compat; v0.6+ first-run-setup emits `global-directive` for persona/master-directive layers.

apiParameter.description: v0.6+. Which API parameter this layer is destined for. `null` = unknown (degrades F12 detection to v0.5 layer-order behavior).

apiParameterConfidence.description: v0.6+. Confidence of the apiParameter heuristic match.

description: vibe-prompt composer.json schema. v0.7 introduces composers[] for multi-composer apps; v0.6 single-composer shape (top-level layers[]) remains valid. At least one of layers / composers must be present.
